entries.title: Leviticus 25:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 25:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD. {keep: Heb. rest}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:3
segments: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

entries.title: Leviticus 25:4
segments: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:5
segments: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: [for] it is a year of rest unto the land. {of thy vine...: Heb. of thy separation}

words.text: That which groweth of its own accord
. {of thy vine...: Heb. of thy separation}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:6
segments: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

words.text: for you; for thee, and for thy servant

entries.title: Leviticus 25:7
segments: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that [are] in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:8
segments: ¶And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:9
segments: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth [day] of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land. {of the jubile: Heb. loud of sound}

words.text: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet
. {of the jubile: Heb. loud of sound}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:10
segments: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout [all] the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

words.text: thereof: it shall be a jubile
unto you; and ye shall return

entries.title: Leviticus 25:11
segments: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather [the grapes] in it of thy vine undressed.

words.text: be unto you: ye shall not sow
of itself in it, nor gather
[the grapes] in it of thy vine undressed

entries.title: Leviticus 25:12
segments: For it [is] the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:13
segments: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:14
segments: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest [ought] of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

entries.title: Leviticus 25:15
segments: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, [and] according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

entries.title: Leviticus 25:16
segments: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for [according] to the number [of the years] of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

words.text: of it: for [according] to the number

entries.title: Leviticus 25:17
segments: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:18
segments: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:19
segments: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:20
segments: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

entries.title: Leviticus 25:21
segments: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:22
segments: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat [yet] of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat [of] the old [store].

entries.title: Leviticus 25:23
segments: ¶The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land [is] mine; for ye [are] strangers and sojourners with me. {for ever: or, to be quite cut off: Heb. for cutting off}

words.text: with me. {for ever: or, to be quite cut off: Heb. for cutting off}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:24
segments: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:25
segments: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away [some] of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

words.text: , and if any of his kin

entries.title: Leviticus 25:26
segments: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it; {himself...: Heb. his hand hath attained and found sufficiency}

words.text: it; {himself...: Heb. his hand hath attained and found sufficiency}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:27
segments: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:28
segments: But if he be not able to restore [it] to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

words.text: [it] to him, then that which is sold

entries.title: Leviticus 25:29
segments: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; [within] a full year may he redeem it.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:30
segments: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that [is] in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

words.text: And if it be not redeemed

entries.title: Leviticus 25:31
segments: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile. {they may...: Heb. redemption belongeth unto it}

words.text: . {they may...: Heb. redemption belongeth unto it}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:32
segments: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, [and] the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:33
segments: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in [the year of] jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites [are] their possession among the children of Israel. {a man...: or, one of the Levites redeem them}

words.text: . {a man...: or, one of the Levites redeem them}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:34
segments: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it [is] their perpetual possession.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:35
segments: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: [yea, though he be] a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee. {fallen...: Heb. his hand faileth} {relieve: Heb. strengthen}

words.text: him: [yea, though he be] a stranger
with thee. {fallen...: Heb. his hand faileth} {relieve: Heb. strengthen}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:36
segments: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:37
segments: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:38
segments: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, [and] to be your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:39
segments: ¶And if thy brother [that dwelleth] by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant: {compel...: Heb. serve thyself with him with the service, etc}

words.text: [that dwelleth] by thee be waxen poor
unto thee; thou shalt not compel
: {compel...: Heb. serve thyself with him with the service, etc}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:40
segments: [But] as an hired servant, [and] as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, [and] shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

words.text: , he shall be with thee, [and] shall serve

entries.title: Leviticus 25:41
segments: And [then] shall he depart from thee, [both] he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

words.text: from thee, [both] he and his children

entries.title: Leviticus 25:42
segments: For they [are] my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen. {as...: Heb. with the sale of a bondman}

words.text: . {as...: Heb. with the sale of a bondman}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:43
segments: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:44
segments: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, [shall be] of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

words.text: , which thou shalt have, [shall be] of the heathen
you; of them shall ye buy

entries.title: Leviticus 25:45
segments: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that [are] with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

words.text: among you, of them shall ye buy
that [are] with you, which they begat
: and they shall be your possession

entries.title: Leviticus 25:46
segments: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit [them for] a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour. {they...: Heb. ye shall serve yourselves with them}

words.text: And ye shall take them as an inheritance
. {they...: Heb. ye shall serve yourselves with them}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:47
segments: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother [that dwelleth] by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger [or] sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family: {wax rich...: Heb. his hand obtain, etc}

words.text: by thee, or to the stock
: {wax rich...: Heb. his hand obtain, etc}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:48
segments: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

entries.title: Leviticus 25:49
segments: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or [any] that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

words.text: him; or if he be able

entries.title: Leviticus 25:50
segments: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

words.text: shall be according unto the number

entries.title: Leviticus 25:51
segments: If [there be] yet many years [behind], according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

words.text: unto them he shall give again

entries.title: Leviticus 25:52
segments: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, [and] according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

entries.title: Leviticus 25:53
segments: [And] as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: [and the other] shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

words.text: shall he be with him: [and the other] shall not rule

entries.title: Leviticus 25:54
segments: And if he be not redeemed in these [years], then he shall go out in the year of jubile, [both] he, and his children with him. {in these...: or, by these means}

words.text: And if he be not redeemed
in these [years], then he shall go out
with him. {in these...: or, by these means}

entries.title: Leviticus 25:55
segments: For unto me the children of Israel [are] servants; they [are] my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
